value.rationale: The result explains a mathematically consequential feature of the new hypothesis: the zero eigenvalue newly permitted in 2026 is unavoidable for the translation-invariant forms used in the dense-prime theorem. It sharpens the source's rank-at-least-seven statement to an exact rank and kernel, supplies a reduced four-dimensional test for translation invariance, and gives a concrete indefinite integral witness. This is a structural clarification of why the new theorem reaches a regime excluded by the predecessor, not an arbitrary parameter slice or a numerical recomputation.
